title: WCAG Accessibility Checker
description: Accessibility auditing platform that discovers pages through sitemaps or domain crawling, renders them in Playwright, and checks WCAG 2.1 A/AA rules with axe-core. Provides risk-scored violation reports, affected DOM elements, PDF/CSV exports, and optional AI-assisted remediation suggestions. Built with Flask, SQLite, Playwright and axe-core.
features: Single-page, sitemap and domain-crawl scanning with configurable discovery limits
Browser-rendered WCAG 2.1 A/AA checks with axe-core and affected DOM selectors
Impact-weighted risk scores, per-page findings, and PDF/CSV reports
Optional AI explanations and suggested remediation code
workflow: Discover URLs from a page, sitemap or internal links
Render each page in Playwright Chromium
Run axe-core and classify accessibility violations
Persist results and expose findings with optional AI guidance
summary: Crawls a site, renders each page in Playwright and checks WCAG 2.1 A/AA with axe-core: risk-scored reports, affected elements, PDF/CSV export and optional AI fixes.
